description: This file defines extension methods for guard clauses specific to basket-related validation within the application core of the eCommerce project. It provides a guard to ensure the basket is not empty during checkout.

classes.name: BasketGuards
classes.description: Contains extension methods for guard clauses related to basket validation, specifically to check if the basket is empty during checkout.
